grammar.label: reflexive pronouns and each other
grammar.form: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves; each other
grammar.meaning: the subject and the object are the same person, or two people act on one another

explanation.en: Use a reflexive when the object is the same as the subject: 'I taught myself'. Use 'each other' when two people act on one another: 'They helped each other'. English does not use a reflexive with wash, shave, dress or feel.
explanation.uz: Ega va to'ldiruvchi bir xil bo'lsa refleksiv olmosh ishlatiladi: 'I taught myself'. Ikki kishi bir-biriga ta'sir qilsa 'each other': 'They helped each other'. Ingliz tilida wash, shave, dress, feel fe'llari bilan refleksiv QO'YILMAYDI.

grammar.positive_example: I fixed it myself, and we helped each other.
grammar.negative_example: I washed myself and then I felt myself tired.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekcha '-in-' o'zlik nisbati va 'o'zi' ko'pincha ingliz refleksiviga to'g'ri kelmaydi; 'I feel myself bad' eng keng tarqalgan xato.
l1_notes.ru: Русское '-ся' и 'себя' переносятся напрямую: отсюда 'I feel myself bad'.

grammar.label: whatever, whenever, however and other -ever words

explanation.en: The -ever words mean 'any … at all': 'Come whenever you like.' 'However' plus an adjective means 'no matter how': 'However hard I try…'
explanation.uz: -ever so'zlari 'qaysi bo'lishidan qat'i nazar' degan ma'noni beradi: 'Come whenever you like.' 'however' + sifat — 'qanchalik ... bo'lmasin': 'However hard I try…'

grammar.positive_example: Whatever you decide, I will support you.
grammar.negative_example: What ever you decide, I will support you.

l1_notes.uz: Bir so'z sifatida yoziladi; 'however' bu yerda 'lekin' emas.
